tei:div.tei:p: 583) 'dzam gling byang phyogs gangs ljongs mdo khams smad// dge bcu'i dpal gyis spras pa'i phun tshogs gnas// a ti dkar phyogs skyong ba gzhi yi bdag /rdo rje ngang dkar dkar gsal dar dkar gsol// g.yas g.yon sba lcag yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// rin chen rgyan spras gro bo g.yu rngog bc-ibs// lcam mor 'ju rag dkar rngog nag bzhon// dar dkar go zu dngul dkar me long bsnams// nang blon dge bsnyen mi nag rta nag can// dar nag 'phyar zhing ber nag brjid par gsol// phyi blon btsan rgod mi dmar rta dmar can// mdung dmar gsor nas khrab rmog ber nag brjid// bka' sdod dregs pa lha klu gnyan gyi sde// 'khor g.yog 'bum phrag mang po'i tshogs dang bcas// mos pa'i snang ngor gnas 'dir myur du gshegs// dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// dgyes rgur 'char ba'i mchod sprin chen po 'dis// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol gzi byin bskyed// sngon tshe rgyal dbang padma sam bha was// dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bka' bsgosadam bzhag srung mar gnyer du gtad// dam bcas tha tshig gnad nas deng bskul na// phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che// dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas par mdzod// 'dzin 584) skyong spel ba'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams// sku tshe bsrings la mdzad phrin rgyas par mdzod// yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu rdzogs ldan gyi// dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yang du khugs par mdzod/ khyad par bdag cag rig 'dzin yon mchod rnams// nad med tshe dpal yon tan bdun ldan mdzod// mdor na ci bcol las rnams thogs med sgrubs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol/
zhes pa rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis brjod pa siddhi rastu//
